messages:
mira_marketing: quick ask for launch copy team: we want a tiny, reproducible bench pack + 2-sentence method note to support a line like "about 2x lower per-token cost with 4-bit quant + adaptive batching". Goal: publish Wed AM. Can runtime do a focused smoke?

ash_runtime: yep. propose quick cohorts: tiny (<=30 tokens), normal (~140), long (~400). hardware = 1x A100. comparisons: fp16 baseline vs 4-bit quant. metrics: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and per-token cost normalized to fp16.

kai_eng: warmup plan: 40 tiny, 15 normal, then measured runs. repeats=4, conc levels 1 and 8. export per-request CSV and a short runbook. include 6 sample traces per cohort for QA.

mira_marketing: legal needs explicit caveats and a plain-language method blurb we can paste. also need S3 link to artifacts and a one-line tag: "initial quant numbers, kernel tuning pending" if tuning not finished.

ash_runtime: noted. we'll label quant runs as initial unless we get time to tune kernels. reproducible payload example below (seed=99):

```
{"input": "Explain Redwood Inference in two short sentences for a product blog.", "max_tokens": 80, "temperature": 0.0, "seed": 99}
```

kai_eng: output CSV schema: request_id, cohort, seq_len, latency_ms, tokens_out, model_id, quant_mode, warmed(bool). We'll produce mean+std and raw CSVs.

deploy-bot: CI job created: https://ci.internal/run/1829998888-smoke, started 1829998920. ETA ~45m.

mira_marketing: great. please include a 2-paragraph plain-language method note: 1) cohorts + counts, 2) warmup and repeats, 3) cost calc summary. legal wants a one-line safe harbor.

legal-bot: suggested text: "Benchmarks were run under controlled conditions on internal hardware; actual results may vary with workload and deployment."

ash_runtime: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1829998888/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csv + traces + logs). fp16 tuned runs included; quant4 runs are initial.

kai_eng: if we get time we can run quick quant tuning (approx +2h) and post updated artifacts to s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1829998888/quant4_tuned/. Otherwise marketing can use initial numbers with caveat.

mira_marketing: thanks — we'll draft copy marking quant as "initial" unless you confirm tuned artifacts by Tue EOD. appreciate the quick turnaround! :sparkles:
